completion_contract: Slice 2A and Slice 2B focused gates pass against one exact isolated candidate; excluded downstream code is not used as evidence; independent Opus 5 xhigh review accepts the frozen candidate; and the resulting commit/hash is published only as the immutable upstream input for later Runtime Slices.
non_goals: replace the current shared Runtime baseline
pass the complete predecessor Runtime test suite
migrate Trading Platform host authoring or real domain Workflows
apply registered Policies through Execution or Ledger
rollback_boundary: Before push, discard only the isolated candidate worktree. After push, retire the candidate ref or revert its candidate branch commit; no shared Runtime release, PostgreSQL schema, or host binding is changed.
